name: Interrupt
useTime: Reaction (when a creature within 5 ft. takes a Major or Minor action)
description: You attempt to disrupt the actions of a creature within 5 ft. Take a Stress to force the target to make a Reflex saving throw. On a failure, the triggering action is interrupted and wasted, but the creature does not expend any resources (spell slots, class features, etc.) On a success, the action continues normally.
